snippet.title: Tiny Witch - Official Gameplay Trailer | Black Voices in Gaming
snippet.description:
Manage a minion store (yep, you heard that right) to satisfy your dungeon master clientele. Cast your spells, alchemize new recipes, and prepare your best minions before your clients' patience runs out!

Tiny Witch is available on PC and mobile now. Play or wishlist it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1740310/Tiny_Witch/
